QuestInfo.name: A Second Look
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9390353##k is still having a hard time. Can't he just put all that baggage on the ground?\r\n
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p9390354##k found that there were three places #bTristan's Sword#k might be located...
But the monsters ate the keys. Get as many Key Fragments as possible at the Second Door, and piece them together.
Use the second key fragments you've collected from your inventory.
#b#p9390354##k says the monsters are near there.
QuestInfo.2: You didn't find anything at the second location.\r\n

0.0: We need to find the second door.
0.1: I guess we should head to the second location. Hunt #bTauromacises#k near the #bCollapsed Temple#k and you can get #bTristan's Second Key Fragments#k. Collect some to piece them together.
0.2: Talk to #b#p9390354##k once you get the key.

yes.0: Get as many Key Fragments as you can. The more, the better.

no.0: Look, I said I'm tired from carrying all this stuff around. Are you going to make me repeat my instructions... AGAIN?

1.0: Hey, you. You look a little different than last time. Did you get the key?

yes.0: You found the key. Give it to me! Let's try it!
yes.1: Welp, this one's no good either!

item.0: Hm, get more Key Fragments to piece together.
